purpose: Two additional region mood illustrations for the PEAK cover series; not screenshots or exact daily map evidence.

assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: PEAK game region atmosphere illustration for a matching illustrated biome-cover set, portrait 1024x1536, edge-to-edge opaque PNG, no UI.
Primary request: PEAK / 顶峰 is a SMALL GENTLE GRASSY HILLOCK at the end of the climb, covered in fresh green grass and little wildflowers. Show a welcoming, intimate rounded rise, NOT a towering pointed mountain or snow peak. A soft worn earth path curves up the short grassy slope to its modest rounded crest. Clumps of small white, pale yellow, pink and lilac wildflowers among lush grass are clearly visible. Soft blue sky with broad fluffy clouds and a distant low cloud horizon conveys altitude without putting big mountain peaks behind it.
Style: cute premium hand-painted adventure-storybook landscape, soft gouache brush texture, painterly faceted chunky shapes, rounded readable silhouettes, warm natural sunshine, gentle atmospheric depth. Match a colorful friendly game-biome series rather than photorealism or epic fantasy. Rocks painted in broad soft warm-grey facets, grass in brushy clustered forms, flowers charming and simple, no outlines around every object.
Composition: portrait immersive landscape, near-eye-level view toward the little summit hill; hill silhouette and flowers readable in the central 70% width and middle 35%-72% height, so it can later be cropped into a small cover panel. Avoid excessive empty sky. Lower foreground quiet with grassy texture for optional external UI overlay, but do not draw any overlay or text.
Constraints: ONLY the requested grassy little hill, wildflowers, a natural path, modest embedded rocks and sky. No buildings, gate, flags, tents, player characters, scouts, animals or invented monuments. No snow, ice, volcano, sharp giant peak or massive sheer cliffs. No labels, typography, logos, watermark, decorative border, split panels. This is a region mood illustration, not a claimed exact map screenshot.

Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: PEAK game NADIR / 天底 region atmosphere illustration for a matching illustrated biome-cover set, portrait 1024x1536, edge-to-edge opaque PNG, no UI.
Primary request: an otherworldly SILVER-WHITE realm made of separate floating mountain fragments pieced together into an ascending route, with one LARGE GATE at the highest point where the scout story is triggered. The mountain fragments are pale silver and chalk-white stone, separated by plainly visible open-air gaps, their jagged undersides suspended above a pale misty void. Varied interlocking cliff fragments and small rocky landings rise in depth, not a single intact mountain and not a regular staircase. The summit gateway is substantial and unmistakable: a broad monumental pale-stone portal with two chunky upright posts and a lintel, a subtly luminous open passage, situated on the highest floating slab. Make the gate the clear story focal point, readable in a small thumbnail. Do not depict the scout cinematic itself or invent dialogue/characters.
Style: cute premium hand-painted adventure-storybook landscape, soft gouache brush texture, simplified chunky faceted rock shapes and softened corners, restrained detail and clear silhouettes. Same approachable painted game-biome family as warm colorful illustrated landscapes, but with its own silver-white palette. Pearly white and light silver stone, cool blue-grey and very pale lilac shadows, diffuse soft light, luminous mist. Silver means pale mineral stone, NOT shiny chrome machinery, NOT a snow/ice landscape.
Composition: portrait view looking gently upward along the floating rock route, near fragments framing the lower foreground, middle-distance fragments clearly disconnected across gaps, uppermost gate fully visible around the upper-middle of the painting with sky margin above. Keep the important route and gate within central 70% width so a narrow vertical cover crop remains legible. Layered sense of distance, enough darker blue-grey negative space between light rocks to distinguish their silhouette. The bottom can be quieter mist and rock texture for optional external UI, with no actual UI.
Constraints: empty environment, no human player figures, no ghosts, no dragons, no angels, no extra floating castles, no giant religious symbols, no scout logos, no ornamental gold, no lush green forest, no snow-capped Alps. No typography, labels, watermark, border, collage or split panels. An evocative game-region illustration, not an exact geometric screenshot.
